changelog: Catch-up release: a site that went from v3.23.0 straight to v3.24.1 via Update Now only ever received v3.24.1's own single-file manifest, silently skipping every file and the one migration from v3.24.0. This release's manifest is the full union of both -- one Update Now now brings any v3.23.0-or-3.24.x site completely current. No code changes beyond what v3.24.0 and v3.24.1 already shipped.

(from v3.24.0) New FSA Gate 1 structure engine (app/js/structure-gate1.js) -- an exact port of the reference TradingView indicator (FSA_Structure_Gate1.pine v4.2): ATR(14) Wilder RMA, hidden zigzag swing detection, HH/HL/LH/LL labeling, and the BOS/CHoCH state machine. Pure, incremental, no DOM -- pushes one already-closed 4H candle at a time, so lookahead is impossible by construction, not just by convention. 500-candle warm-up on every session open/resume; a rewind resets and replays from the warm-up start rather than patching anything in place.

(from v3.24.0) The replay chart now draws Gate 1 swing labels, BOS (solid) / CHoCH (dashed) lines, and a badge (top-right, exact wording/levels from the Pine indicator) on the existing drawing canvas -- toggleable from the draw toolbar (default on). A forming 4H candle's wick never affects the badge; only its close, once fully revealed in replay time, can.

(from v3.24.0) Every backtest order now records gate1_auto_state (the engine's own reading at order time, sent unconditionally) and, when the v3.23.0 gate checklist opens, an always-present 'Gate 1 (Structure)' row pre-checked per the indicator's own direction-aware suggestion -- the trader can override it. gate1_agree (1 = kept the suggestion, 0 = overrode it) is recorded only then. Neither field is enforced.
(from v3.24.0) The session Results page and Saved Backtests summary each gained a 'trader vs indicator agreed/disagreed on gate 1' row, shown only for sessions with gate1_agree data.

(from v3.24.0) Fixed: the pre-order gate checklist (live journal and backtest ticket both) could grow taller than the screen with nothing to scroll it, pushing the Proceed/Cancel buttons off-screen on a long gate list. The popup now caps at 90vh with only the item list scrolling; each row collapses to a short title with the full rule text behind a '▾' that doesn't also toggle the checkbox. No change to what gets saved.

(from v3.24.1) Fixed a real porting bug in the FSA Gate 1 engine: hiSince()/loSince() picked the wrong swing candle on a tie (two candles sharing the exact same extreme price within a scan range). Pine seeds its scan from the confirming candle and walks backward, keeping the LATER tied candle on a tie; the port did a forward scan instead and silently kept the EARLIER one. Caught by the first real Pine-exported fixture set (BTC/LINK/LIT/PUMPFUN).
release_notes: Union manifest fix for the v3.23.0->v3.24.1 skipped-update incident: updater.php's apply action only ever downloads the single remote version.json's own files/db_migrations -- it does not replay or union intermediate releases' manifests. A site that updated directly from v3.23.0 to v3.24.1 therefore received only js/structure-gate1.js (v3.24.1's lone changed file) and never got v3.24.0's other 11 files or its migration. This release's files array is the full union of v3.24.0's and v3.24.1's manifests (duplicate entry -- js/structure-gate1.js -- listed once, carrying v3.24.1's corrected content, since that supersedes v3.24.0's). migrations/2026_10_10_0001_add_backtest_gate1_columns.sql is included in files so migrate.php (the tracked runner, §3A) picks it up from disk after this deploys -- db_migrations stays [] per the established convention (that array is the legacy inline-SQL-exec mechanism and is not file-path based; the tracked runner is what actually applies this migration). No source files changed from what's already at HEAD (v3.24.1) -- this is a manifest-only release. Re-verified before tagging: gate1_parity.js 4/4 fixtures (BTC/LINK/LIT/PUMPFUN) passing, lookahead self-test passing, full harness (every drive*.mjs driver + scan-duplicate-names.mjs) green, backtest_engine.php self-test 104/104, php -l and node --check clean. Deploy workflow for Acrob: Update Now applies all 13 files, then run migrate.php?mode=run&token=... (step 9 of the release checklist) -- this is not automatic.
